description.narrative:
Project activities were being carried out at a limited scale when in July 2024 the overall country context changed drastically following the student-led mass uprising which led to the ouster of the the previous government. Since August 8th 2024, an interim government is in place with national elections expected to be held in February 2026.
The change in government brought about a vacuum especially with regard to maintaining law and order as well as in terms of representation at the local level. These factors have contributed to an alarming increase in violence against women (VAW). Fundamentalist forces propagating conservatism has also made it difficult for women's rights organisations (WROs) to be fully active. Under these circumstances, BMP intensified its efforts towards social norms change, advocating for the proper implementation of laws and policies to ensure justice for survivors.
Some examples of outcomes achieved during this period:
Enhanced Youth Engagement: Increased participation of students and youth organizations in study circles and discussions fostered awareness of gender equality and social justice.
Capacity Strengthening: Over 1,200 participants benefited from training programs, improving leadership, advocacy, and organizational skills.
Expanded Organizational Reach: Membership growth to 144,848 and increased grassroots branches strengthened BMPs nationwide network.
Policy Advocacy Impact: Research findings and policy discussions contributed to shaping gender-related policies and awareness campaigns.
Some Challenges:
Engagement Barriers: Difficulty in sustaining long-term engagement of young participants due to academic and professional commitments.
Resistance to Change: Traditional societal norms and gender biases posed obstacles in promoting progressive discussions on womens rights.
Coordination with Stakeholders: Challenges in aligning objectives and commitments among government agencies, NGOs, and grassroots activists.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
